Comprehension:Read the given passage and answer the questions that follow.Isis, Egyptian Aset or Eset, is one of the most important goddesses of ancient Egypt. Her name is the Greek form of an Egyptian word for “throne.” Though initially obscure, she rose in prominence and was later worshipped across the Roman Empire, from England to Afghanistan. She is still revered by some pagans today.Isis has been associated with being a magical healer because she cured the sick and brought the deceased to life. She was also a model mother and a key figure in funeral rites.According to myth, she was married to Osiris, king of Egypt. His jealous brother Seth trapped him in a wooden chest and threw it into the Nile. Isis found Osiris in Byblos and brought him back to Egypt. After Seth hacked Osiris into pieces, Isis, aided by her sister Nephthys, transformed into a bird, found all the parts, and magically reassembled him. Osiris lived on as a mummy.Isis is often depicted as a beautiful woman wearing a sheath dress and a throne-shaped crown or solar disk with cow’s horns. She is also represented as a bird, symbolizing her magical transformation during the search for Osiris.Isis, in Egyptian myth, has been associated with being ‘a magical healer’ because:
options: She brought her lost husband back to his kingdom Egypt.
She conspired with Seth to turn her husband into a mummy.
She was a beautiful woman and she loved her husband.
She could instill life into a dead person and heal an ailing person.
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'D' (She could instill life into a dead person and heal an ailing person.) है।

questions.question: Comprehension:Read the given passage and answer the questions that follow. American literature has undergone a profound transformation from its early colonial roots to its present-day complexity. The initial literary works, often theological in nature, reflected the Puritan settlers’ rigid worldview, emphasising moral rectitude and divine providence. Writers such as Jonathan Edwards and Anne Bradstreet used their prose and poetry to navigate religious devotion and personal introspection. However, as the colonies moved towards independence, literature took on a more political tone, with figures like Thomas Paine and Benjamin Franklin using rhetorical finesse to galvanise revolutionary sentiment.The 19th century marked a period of literary expansion, as American authors sought to carve a distinct identity apart from European influences. Romanticism flourished with writers like Nathaniel Hawthorne and Edgar Allan Poe, whose works explored psychological depth, human fallibility and gothic sensibilities. Simultaneously, transcendentalists such as Ralph Waldo Emerson and Henry David Thoreau championed individualism and nature’s spiritual significance. By the latter half of the century, realism emerged as a counterpoint to romantic idealism, with Mark Twain and Henry James depicting life’s intricacies through meticulous detail and social critique.The 20th century saw American literature fracture into numerous stylistic and thematic branches. Modernist writers like TS Eliot and William Faulkner experimented with fragmented narratives and stream-of-consciousness techniques, reflecting the disillusionment of a rapidly changing world. The Harlem Renaissance brought forth voices such as Langston Hughes, who redefined African American identity in literature. In the postmodern era, figures like Thomas Pynchon and Don DeLillo interrogated the nature of truth, media and technological encroachment on human experience.American literature continues to evolve, encapsulating diverse perspectives and experimental forms. It serves not only as a reflection of historical and cultural shifts but also as an ever-adapting narrative of the American consciousness. Which of the following best describes the structure of the passage?
options: It focuses on modern American literary movements.
It contrasts American and European literature in various periods.
It critiques the impact of technological advancements on literature.
It presents a chronological progression of American literature.
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'D' (It presents a chronological progression of American literature.) है।

Comprehension:Read the given passage and answer the questions that follow.The study of ancient civilisations provides valuable insights into human history, offering a window into the lives of people who lived thousands of years ago. Archaeological discoveries have shed light on the daily lives and customs of ancient peoples, revealing how they lived, worked and interacted with their environment. These findings help us understand the development of cultures and societies, showing us the evolution of human civilisation over time. For instance, the excavation of ancient cities has uncovered artifacts such as tools, pottery and inscriptions that tell us about the technological advancements, trade practices and social structures of these societies.However, interpreting these artifacts can be challenging due to limited information. Often, archaeologists must piece together incomplete records and fragmented objects to form a coherent picture of the past. This process requires a great deal of expertise and often involves making educated guesses based on the available evidence. The context in which an artifact is found can significantly influence its interpretation, and without a complete understanding of this context, our conclusions may be tentative or subject to revision.Ongoing research and technological advances continue to reveal new aspects of ancient civilisations. Modern techniques such as radiocarbon dating, DNA analysis and remote sensing have revolutionised the field of archaeology, allowing researchers to obtain more precise and detailed information about ancient peoples and their environments.Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word as used in the passage.

Tentative

Comprehension:Read the following passage carefully and answer the questions that follow.Electric vehicles (EVs) are increasingly perceived as a panacea for climate change, yet their environmental benefits are more nuanced than commonly portrayed. While EVs emit zero tailpipe emissions, their overall ecological footprint hinges on factors like battery production, mining of rare earth metals, and electricity generation sources. Manufacturing EV batteries is energy-intensive and often depends on lithium, cobalt, and nickel—resources predominantly extracted under ethically questionable conditions. Moreover, the carbon impact of EVs varies geographically; in regions reliant on coal-fired power plants, EVs may contribute to indirect emissions. Nonetheless, technological advances in battery recycling and the global shift towards renewable energy offer a promising outlook. Despite these complexities, EV adoption is accelerating due to policy incentives, reduced operating costs, and growing consumer awareness. The challenge lies in striking a balance between innovation and sustainability to truly harness the green potential of electric mobility.Which three metals are primarily involved in EV battery production?
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'B' (Lithium, Cobalt, and Nickel) है।

questions.question: Comprehension:Read the given passage and answer the questions that follow.Imagine an India where every prisoner is not just serving time but also preparing for a second chance at life. Education behind bars is often an overlooked solution to reducing recidivism, fostering economic reintegration, and building a more inclusive society. With India’s prison population exceeding 5.5 lakh inmates as of 2023, tapping into this human potential can address critical socio-economic challenges through Prison Education in India. India’s prisons are largely overcrowded, operating at 130% of their capacity. Nearly 77% of inmates are under trials, many of whom lack access to quality education or vocational training. This underutilises a massive workforce that could contribute to the nation’s economy if equipped with relevant knowledge and skills. While India has made strides in prison reforms, education for prisoners remains an area with significant potential. The National Policy on Prison Reforms 2017 emphasises the importance of education and skill development within prisons. However, challenges such as inadequate infrastructure, limited resources, and lack of trained personnel hinder the full implementation of these policies. While some prisons offer basic literacy programs, these initiatives are sparse and lack a structured curriculum. For example, the Tihar Jail in Delhi and Yerawada Jail in Pune run vocational courses, but only a small percentage of prisoners benefit from them. A 2022 study by the National Crime Records Bureau (NCRB) shows that educated prisoners are 50% less likely to reoffend compared to their uneducated counterparts. Literacy not only empowers them but also instils a sense of responsibility.What can be inferred about the role of education in prisoners' lives?
options: Education helps in the rehabilitation of prisoners and their reintegration into society.
Education programs in prisons are only for a small group of prisoners.
Education is not necessary for prisoners' improvement.
Education is seen as a way to maintain control over prisoners.
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'A' (Education helps in the rehabilitation of prisoners and their reintegration into society.) है।

Comprehension:दिए गए गद्यांश के आधार पर निम्नांकित प्रश्नों के उत्तर दीजिए-- रामभक्ति शाखा में रामकाव्य के महत्त्वपूर्ण कवि तुलसीदास के अतिरिक्त भी कुछ कवि हैं। उन रामभक्त कवियों में ही रामानंद का नाम आता है। रामानंद ने भक्ति को शास्त्रीय मर्यादा के बंधन से मुक्त माना। जाति और वर्ण के भेदभाव से ऊपर उठकर भक्ति को जनसामान्य से जोड़ने का प्रयत्न किया। इसलिए रामानंद की शिष्य परंपरा का संबंध रामभक्ति शाखा के तपसी और उदासी सम्प्रदाय से जोड़ा जाता है, वहीं निर्गुण भक्ति के ज्ञानमार्गी परंपरा से भी उनका संबंध संकेतित किया जाता है। रामानंद के कुछ पद हनुमान जी की स्तुति के रूप में प्रचलित हैं। दूसरे रामभक्त कवियों में अग्रदास का नाम प्रमुख है। अग्रदास ने रामभक्ति को कृष्ण भक्ति के लोकानुरंजन के समीप लाने का प्रयत्न किया। उनके काव्य में अष्टयाम अथवा रामाष्टयाम को मुख्य माना जाता है। राम के ऐश्वर्य रूप की झाँकी इन लीलाओं में स्पष्ट दिखाई देती है। इन्होंने सखी सम्प्रदाय के लिए रास्ता साफ कर दिया। ईश्वर दास भी रामभक्त कवि थे। रामकथा से संबंद्ध उनकी रचनाओं में ‘भरत मिलाप’ और ‘अंगद पैज’ प्रमुख है। इन कवियों के अतिरिक्त, नाभादास जैसे कवियों ने भी रामभक्ति परम्परा में अपना महत्त्वपूर्ण योगदान दिया। नाभादास ने अपने प्रसिद्ध ग्रंथ 'भक्तमाल' में विभिन्न भक्तों और संतों के जीवन और उनकी भक्ति-साधना का विस्तृत वर्णन किया है, जिसमें रामभक्त कवियों का भी उल्लेख मिलता है।70इ4'भरत मिलाप' निम्न में से किसकी रचना है--707

questions.question: Comprehension:दिए गए गद्यांश के आधार पर निम्नलिखित प्रश्नों का उत्तर दीजिए।आधुनिक साहित्य में वस्तु-स्थिति-चित्रण की प्रवृत्ति इतनी बढ़ रही है कि आज की कहानी यथासम्भव प्रत्यक्ष अनुभवों की सीमा से बाहर नहीं जाती। हमें केवल इतना सोचने से ही संतोष नहीं होता कि मनोविज्ञान की दृष्टि से ये सभी पात्र मनुष्यों से मिले-जुलते हैं, बल्कि हम यह इत्मीनान चाहते हैं कि वे सचमुच मनुष्य हैं और लेखक ने यथासम्भव उनका जीवन-चरित्र ही लिखा है, क्योंकि कल्पना के गढ़े हुए आदमियों में हमारा विश्वास नहीं है, उनके कार्यो और विचारों से हम प्रभावित नहीं होते। हमें इसका निश्चय हो जाना चाहिए कि लेखक ने जो सृष्टि की है, वह प्रत्यक्ष अनुभवों के आधार पर की गई है और अपने पात्रों की ज़बान से वह खुद बोल रहा है। इसीलिए साहित्य को कुछ समालोचकों ने लेखक का मनोवैज्ञानिक जीवन-चरित्र कहा है।प्रस्तुत गद्यांश में किस बात पर अधिक बल दिया गया है?
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'B' (साहित्य में यथार्थ) है।
